violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))
violation_type.short_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect
violation_type.typical_finding: The operational policies did not include all the required information for abuse and neglect.

finding_variants.text: The operational policies did not include all the required information for abuse and neglect.
The operational policy did not contain the preventing and responding to abuse and neglect section.
The operational policy did not contain a preventing and responding to abuse and neglect section.

The operational policies reviewed were missing the following information:    Preventing and responding to abuse and neglect of children, including:     (A) Required annual training for employees;     (B) Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of issues regarding child abuse and neglect, including warning signs that a child may be a victim of abuse or neglect and factors indicating a child is at risk for abuse or neglect;     (C) Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of prevention techniques for child abuse and neglect;     (D) Strategies for coordination between the center and appropriate community organizations; and     (E) Actions that the parent of a child who is a victim of abuse or neglect should take to obtain assistance and intervention, including procedures for reporting child abuse or neglect;

Information on preventing  and responding to abuse and neglect needs to be included in the operational policies/parent handbook to include the following:    (A)Required annual training for employees    (B)Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of issues regarding child abuse and neglect, including warning signs that a child may be a victim of abuse or neglect and factors indicating a child is at risk for abuse or neglect     (C)Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of prevention techniques for child abuse and neglect     (D) Strategies for coordination between the center and appropriate community organizations; and    (E)Actions that the parent of a child who is a victim of abuse or neglect should take to obtain assistance and intervention, including procedures for reporting child abuse or neglect
The operatonal policies section on Abuse and Neglect is not comprehensive according to minimum standards.
